title: Fixed irrigation input normalization to typed source application
protocol: PIN_B1_11_NORMALIZATION_AND_TASK3_SOURCE -> NORMALIZE_EVENT -> APPLY_EXISTING_TYPED_FIXED_EVENT -> COMPARE_FULL_EVENT_SOURCE_AMOUNT -> 100000_DETERMINISTIC_EVENTS -> O0_O2_REPLAY -> HOLD_ACCEPTED_SOIL_MASS

equations: normalize input depth/rate, including omitted-rate fallback and SSDI per-node depth split
assign uniform source rate to surface or selected SSDI node range
over the complete event, the integrated source-vector amount equals the input gross depth (within floating-point roundoff)

scope: compose the isolated input normalizer with the existing typed fixed-event materializer using explicit rate input
sprinkler, surface and SSDI types, and 1-5 SSDI nodes
non_goals: input-file parsing, event calendars, timing ownership or grid-depth-to-node lookup
legacy omitted-rate fallback composition (covered by the standalone normalization oracle; the B1 duration guard can reject >1-day values after floating-point conversion)
accepted Richards flux, infiltration, solute transport, whole-column balance or restart
pass_conditions: normalized event completes and application source amount equals source gross input depth
100000 deterministic comparisons pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
